messages.author: 3376a14ec4e06f88
messages.subject: Summary Function
parts:
Hi,

Is there a summary function for ggtree? This is how I would like it to work, I have attached a picture of a section of my tree below and metadata file.

Accession1/Column3
org1/A
org2/A
org3/A
org4/A
org5/B
org6/B
org7/B
org8/C
org9/C
org10/D
org11/D
org12/A
org13/B

I would like a summary for a particular metadata column (in this case Column3)  to be produced for each internal node, counting its occurrences and continuing that with further nodes to the left.

For example, in the tree attached to this, I would like a summary to be similar to this:

Node | A | B ....
20 | 2 | 0 ....
19 | 3 | 0 .....
18 | 4 | 0 .....
17 | 4 | 1 ....

I would like to do this, because I would like to use geom_inset to plot a summary graph for each internal node.

If there isn't one, I am happy to attempt to write one.
